description: A polished static browser app for creating, previewing, validating, printing, and downloading professional invoices.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Plain browser JavaScript with no build step, ideal for a portable static app.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed source with a compilation step.

questions.rationale: The request is for a static browser app in an empty folder, so plain JavaScript keeps it immediately runnable.

questions.question: What should the invoice workflow include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Create invoice details and line items, calculate subtotal/tax/discount/total, validate required fields, preview a print-ready invoice, print, and download a PDF through the browser print dialog.
questions.answer: Create invoice details and line items, calculate subtotal/tax/discount/total, validate required fields, preview a print-ready invoice, print, and download a PDF through the browser print dialog.
questions.rationale: These are the core actions needed for a useful invoice generator without a backend.

sharedQuestions.question: Which data stores does the application require?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Keep invoice data in the browser session and export it through print/download.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Persist invoices in a relational database.

sharedQuestions.rationale: No backend, persistence, uploads, or shared invoice history was requested.

sharedQuestions.question: Should users sign in to access application API features?

options.label: No
options.description: Use the app directly in the browser without sign-in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Require users to sign in before accessing application API features.

sharedQuestions.rationale: This is a self-contained static browser utility with no application API.
